rules: A parent run must explicitly claim delegation authority, and every claimed action must remain within its resolved project role and identity authority.
Delegated authority cannot exceed validated parent authority.
Tool grants do not imply approval authority.
A child run cannot exceed delegated authority, tools, budget, deadline, expiry, or scope.
Delegated and child scopes cannot contain or enter a forbidden scope.
Delegation requires an expiry and termination condition.
Every child run traces to exactly one parent delegation.
Every checkpoint binds to its exact project, delegation, and child run.
Delegated context binds the immutable delegation digest and repository sources remain in delegated scope.
Cancellation propagates to active child work.
An executor cannot become the sole evaluator or promoter.
Budgets aggregate across parent and child runs.
A failed authority check blocks execution.
Messages cannot mutate governed state directly.
